Hi Jordan & Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciate the open conversation and the context on Brightline’s evaluation goals. Quick recap of what we heard on our side: 

- Primary use case: in-product smart summaries and retrieval-augmented generation for customer support.
- Key constraints: must support ~5–10k monthly active agents, sub-200ms token latency target for short responses, and EU data residency for logs (some customers require).
- Success metrics: 30% reduction in average handle time (AHT) and maintain answer accuracy > 92% on your internal evaluation set.

Next step: we recommend a focused 30-minute product intro/demo that shows a short live walkthrough of the runtime, prompt routing, and how caching/batching can reduce costs for your workload. Please pick one of these windows (all ET):

1) Tue Jul 5 — 11:00–11:30 AM ET
2) Wed Jul 6 — 11:00–11:30 AM ET
3) Thu Jul 7 — 2:30–3:00 PM ET

If none work, tell me two windows that do and we’ll move. It would be ideal if Priya (Head of ML) and your engineering lead can join; otherwise Jordan, we can do a short exec-lite walkthrough and schedule a deeper technical follow-up.

I’ve attached quick discovery notes from today (discovery_notes.pdf). I’ll loop in Tessa (our solutions engineer) to lead the demo if you confirm a slot.

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

Best,
Jasmine Liu

- 2:00–12:00 min: live demo — hosted API + routing to dedicated variants
